newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovene bourse sees capitalisation tripled by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Slovene bourse sees capitalisation tripled by 2000.

text.p: Market capitalisation of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange is expected to treble to 1,000 billion tolars ($6.4 billion) by the year 2000, the bourse's head said on Friday.
"We expect to have about 300 securities on all sectors of the market by then," head Drasko Veselinovic told a news conference.
There is currently a total of 109 shares, bonds and short-term securities listed on the main and over-the-counter (OTC) markets.

Veselinovic said he expected the number of brokerages to fall to between 25 to 30 from the present 46 due to possible mergers following expected tougher legislatory demands of the sector. He gave no further details. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 156.6 Slovenian Tolars)
